title: Algorithm Distillation for Safe In-Context Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.21524v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Safe in-context reinforcement learning (Safe ICRL) asks a policy with fixed parameters to improve on an unseen constrained task from its interaction history while aiming to keep its cost within a budget. Prior work studied Safe ICRL on five benchmarks in three families: a grid world with a hidden goal and obstacles (DarkRoom), continuous navigation where goals and hazards stay invisible until reached (PointGoal, CarGoal), and locomotion with a hidden velocity limit (HalfCheetah, Ant). Safe Algorithm Distillation (Safe AD), trained on the learning histories of a safe RL algorithm, has shown adaptation failures in prior evaluations. For example, in the locomotion tasks its return stays below zero, and it rarely reaches the goal in CarGoal. We revisit two parts of Safe AD. First, we distill a budget-aware teacher with two phases. translated_title: 面向安全上下文强化学习的算法蒸馏
translated_abstract: 安全上下文强化学习（Safe ICRL）要求一个参数固定的策略从其交互历史中，在未见过的受约束任务上进行改进，同时力求将其成本控制在预算之内。先前的工作在三个系列的五个基准上研究了 Safe ICRL：具有隐藏目标和障碍的网格世界、目标和危险在到达前不可见的连续导航（PointGoal、CarGoal），以及具有隐藏速度限制的运动控制任务。安全算法蒸馏（Safe AD）通过在安全强化学习算法的学习历史上进行训练，在先前的评估中表现出适应失败。例如，在运动控制任务中其回报始终低于零，并且在 CarGoal 中很少能到达目标。我们重新审视了 Safe AD 的两个部分。首先，我们蒸馏一个具有两个阶段的预算感知教师。它搜索隐藏任务，并在剩余预算较多时进行更多探索。在其首次获得奖励或成本之后……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文重新审视安全算法蒸馏方法，通过蒸馏一个具有两阶段的预算感知教师，解决 Safe AD 在安全上下文强化学习未见任务上适应失败的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper revisits Safe Algorithm Distillation by distilling a budget-aware two-phase teacher to address the adaptation failures of Safe AD in safe in-context reinforcement learning on unseen constrained tasks.
